title: Tunisian Chicken Tagine with Almonds
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Tunisia, made with chicken, almonds, and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: Heat oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, tagine spice blend, and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken, cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add almonds, apricots, and honey. Stir to combine.
Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
Note: Traditionally, this dish is cooked in a clay tagine over an open flame.
If you don't have a tagine, use a large Dutch oven or saucepan with a heavy lid.
Adjust cooking time and liquid levels accordingly.
